clue.text: Gold beats yttrium in stiff test

blocks.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
to top a rival is to beat them

explanation.surface: A chemistry lab result: gold outperforms yttrium in some tough materials test.
explanation.walkthrough: A stiff is slang for a corpse, so the stiff test is the post-mortem examination, not a test of rigidity.
explanation.definitionFit: A corpse is called a stiff in slang, and a post-mortem examination of one is exactly what this medical procedure is.

clue.text: Oblivious in Cameroun — a war expected

explanation.definitionFit: Being oblivious means having no knowledge or awareness of what is happening around you.

clue.text: Mock the art set without frames and colour

the middle letter of the

clue.text: Castrate violently without using a spray

the first letter of rival

clue.text: Going to a restaurant, or dine at home, with painful disease

clue.text: Guilty party's rip-off concealed by religious group

clue.text: Did you pen best composition? Absolutely!

clue.text: Commandos on hotel window

explanation.definitionFit: A sash is a sliding frame of glass, and sash is common shorthand for the whole vertical-sliding type of glazing.

clue.text: Consider the same sick lady outside as well enough

clue.text: Currency unknown following gold standard

clue.text: Took no action on rent — stupidly I tried!

clue.text: Now's the wrong time to constrain mass communications

clue.text: When life begins to be a bit like a stronghold?

clue.text: Dodger may be lucky

clue.text: Wonderful magazine, incompletely edited

clue.text: Studs in tatty clothing not for them
